name: team_planning_plan_members
description: List the members of a Team Planning plan the caller is in, each a person id, their name, a role (editor or viewer) and see_pay: whether they hold the see-pay right. A holder also has see_pay_granted, saying who granted it, when, and whether a tenant admin restored it to a plan locked out of pay. A forgotten person reads as "Former member". Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
